newsitem.title: NORWAY: Tankers await weather window at N. Sea oilfields.
newsitem.headline: Tankers await weather window at N. Sea oilfields.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS said on Thursday strong winds and high swell continued to prevent offshore loadings at the North Sea Statfjord and Gullfaks oilfields, but production remained normal.
Statoil said there were five shuttle tankers waiting for a break in the weather to moor up to the loading buoys.
"We are hoping for an opening around midnight, but for the moment all production is normal," a Statoil spokeswoman said.

Statfjord pumps about 380,000 barrel per day (bpd) and processes crude from the Statfjord East and North satellites and the nearby Snorre and Vigdis developments, which in total add roughly 400,000 bpd to the Statfjord stream.
Gullfaks produces around 475,000 bpd and handles around 85,000 bpd of output from the Tordis field.
